responsibility: Implements the GIMPLE-level semantic comparison engine for IPA identical code folding. The func_checker logic compares SSA names, declarations, edges, labels, switches, returns, asm statements, and polymorphic/type properties so candidate functions can be proven equivalent before the higher-level ICF pass merges them.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual GIMPLE semantic-equivalence checker used by IPA ICF, with func_checker method implementations for SSA names, declarations, CFG edges, labels, switches, returns, asm, and operand classification. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf-gimple.h, it executes the comparisons rather than just declaring the checker framework and logging helpers.
